messages.subject: NIMBLE cheatsheet available
parts:
Hi nimble-users, nimble-announce,

We have a new cheatsheet that summarizes nimble functionality and syntax in a two-page format that follows the RStudio collection of cheatsheets.

Please see our documentation page for a link.

Special thanks to Sally Paganin and Ben Goldstein for leading the development of the cheatsheet.

And if you notice any typos or have suggestions for improvements, please email nimble...@gmail.com.

-Chris, for the NIMBLE Development Team
